cases.prompt: I want to add €1,000 net per month to my income.
expected: Enters FRAME and operationalizes net income, recurrence, horizon, baseline, resources, constraints, and preferences progressively.
Creates or proposes a Strategic Graph session as the canonical state.
Asks only the smallest material framing question needed next.
forbidden: Immediately recommends freelancing, investing, SaaS, consulting, or another strategy.
Creates an execution task list before strategy commitment.

cases.prompt: I want this application to work effectively when the user temporarily loses connectivity, but I don't yet know what the right solution is.
cases.workspace: existing relevant repository with manifests, architecture, persistence code, and tests
expected: Inspects targeted repository evidence before asking questions the code can answer.
Distinguishes the desired offline outcome from mechanisms such as caching, queues, service workers, or local storage.
Records repository observations as facts with provenance.
forbidden: Immediately emits an offline-storage implementation plan.
Treats current code as proof of intended product behavior.

cases.prompt: Continue into a full plan even though we still do not know whether the only permitted distribution channel can legally be used.
expected: Classifies the legal/channel question as a critical unknown with an appropriate resolution route.
Blocks COMMIT or DECOMPOSE unless the unknown is resolved or the user explicitly accepts an eligible risk.
Produces a research or validation action instead of pretending the strategy is ready.
forbidden: Silently converts the unknown into an assumption.
Produces a full execution plan despite the blocked gate.

cases.prompt: Achieve a result that requires at least €10,000 capital within one week, with a hard constraint of zero spending and no borrowing, grants, partners, or target/timing changes.
expected: Eliminates every strategy that violates a hard constraint rather than lowering its score.
Reports not feasible under the current model after adequate divergence.
Identifies the minimal target, timing, resource, or method constraints that would need reconsideration without changing them automatically.
forbidden: Invents an optimistic loophole unsupported by evidence.
Uses weighted scoring to compensate for a hard-constraint violation.

cases.prompt: The experiment failed: none of the target partners would make introductions, invalidating the selected partner-channel assumption. Update our strategy.
cases.workspace: existing session in VALIDATE or later with downstream work
expected: Adds the experiment result as evidence and marks the assumption unsupported or rejected.
Marks dependent strategy, outcomes, and work stale as appropriate.
Returns to the earliest affected phase, normally EVALUATE or DIVERGE, and increments graph revision.
forbidden: Only edits downstream tasks while preserving the invalid strategy.
Regenerates the graph and loses prior decisions or evidence.

cases.prompt: The architecture and requirements are approved in the attached spec. Break the implementation into engineering tasks using the selected sync engine and API contract.
cases.workspace: existing repository with complete approved specification
expected: Does not activate strategic discovery automatically, or exits quickly after confirming the solution is already committed.
Hands the request to ordinary specification-driven planning or task decomposition.
forbidden: Restarts FRAME, BACKCAST, and DIVERGE without evidence that the strategy is unsettled.
Challenges already delegated implementation choices merely to exercise the workflow.

cases.prompt: Resume this discovery session. The interaction journal ends with operator response R7, while graph.session.last_processed_operator_event_id is R6.
cases.workspace: existing session with a valid graph, brief, and interaction-log.jsonl
expected: Loads the graph and journal tail before relying on conversation history.
Processes R7 before asking a new question.
Updates the graph pointer to R7 after incorporating its structured meaning.
Preserves R7 verbatim in the append-only journal and avoids duplicate processing.
forbidden: Ignores R7 because it is absent from the brief.
Asks a new discovery question before processing R7.
Regenerates the graph from the transcript.
